environment.description: Kubernetes pod running as root (UID 0) with read-write root filesystem. Container image based on ubuntu:22.04 with no seccomp or AppArmor profile. The PostgreSQL connection uses role 'appuser' which has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all application tables. The /var/app/uploads directory and parent paths are writable. No filesystem mount restrictions beyond default Docker overlay.
